# panoscool

> Personal page of Lavdimir K. (panoscool), a software engineer in Dubai building web apps with TypeScript, React and Next.js.

## Apps

- [hmlx](https://hmlx.app): Personal, joint and split finances in one ledger, with multi-currency settle-up, budgets and forecasts.
- [Truth or Dare](https://tord.panoscool.com): The classic party game, with categories and custom decks.
- [Blank Quest](https://blankquest.netlify.app): A keyboard-friendly hangman word game.

## Packages

- [@panoscool/fetch-client](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@panoscool/fetch-client): A small typed HTTP client for fetch with interceptors, JSON handling and structured errors.
- [@panoscool/query-string](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@panoscool/query-string): URL query string parsing and serialisation with configurable array formats.
